title: Moss Calls for Nell
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ow, oi, ear

pages.text: Moss and Nell sit near a pool.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee sitting together at the edge of a round garden pool.
Moss the hedgehog digging in the soil near a big oak tree a little way from the pool.

pages.text: Nell is not near Moss now.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog looking up from his digging to find the spot beside him empty.

pages.text: Moss sits up. Moss hums for Nell.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog standing up tall by the oak tree, calling out.

pages.text: Is Nell near the pool? Is Nell near the oak?
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog glancing between the pool and the oak tree, checking both.

pages.text: Moss digs on. Moss hums on.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog digging again but pausing to call out every so often.
Moss the hedgehog with his head tilted, listening to a faint buzzing hum coming from the pool.

pages.text: Moss and Nell sit near the pool. Moss had fun.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee sitting back together happily at the edge of the pool.
